text:
sara: FYI seeing a provisioning surge fail in ap-northeast-1. New GPU nodes never finish boot, kubelet stuck, logs show KMS decrypt errors. Not sure if this is a policy change or networking.
raj: ugh, saw alerts too. Which error exactly? paste?
sara: snippet from instance syslog: `ERROR: failed to fetch bootstrap secrets: kms:DecryptAccessDeniedException`
leah: I just pushed a minor KMS policy tweak for service-account scoping ~06:50 UTC. Rolling forward a canary only, but maybe the role ARN pattern got stricter.
tony: that canary was only for eu-*, right? shouldnt affect apac. did you change principal conditions?
leah: I added `StringLike` on aws:PrincipalArn to limit to `arn:aws:iam::*:role/redwood-bootstrap-*`. Might have accidentally matched boot role in apac where we use `redwood-bootstrap-ap` naming.
sara: nodes use `redwood-bootstrap-apac` role. If condition is too strict they'd get denied.
raj: pivot plan: 1) add temporary KMS allow for the apac boot role 2) drain and reprovision stuck nodes 3) follow up with policy fix. Who can apply?
leah: I can patch the key policy to add a short-term principal exception. Doing it now, will DM compliance.
deploy-bot: audit-log: kms:ModifyKeyPolicy performed by leah@redwood (ip=52.22.11.4) at 1955551248
sara: after leah's change, new node boots started succeeding. Confirming 3/4 stuck nodes recovered.
infra-ci: alert cleared: node-provision-failure-apne1 at 1955551262
tony: what about the cluster-autoscaler backlog? We had ~40 pending pods across realtime queues. Any cost/latency impact?
sara: latency spike for realtime inference paths ~07:10-07:35 UTC, p50 doubled, p95 3x. We routed some traffic to eu-west as fallback which kept tail latency acceptable but increased egress cost.
raj: rough estimate on cost delta?
sara: short term egress to eu-west ~0.8TB, ~$90. Also we spun on-demand GPUs while autoscaler retried, maybe ~$120 extra.
leah: sorry about that. Compliance note: I opened a ticket with legal since I temporarily added a principal to the key policy. Need documented justification for 30-day exception.
raj: action items: - leah: create minimal policy fix to match both naming schemes and remove temp exception (ETA ~EOD) - sara: postmortem with timeline + cost impact - tony: validate autoscaler backoff settings so pending pools don't spin extra on demand; propose changelist
sara: one more weirdness: another error in VPC flow logs showed rejected connections from apac nodes to kms endpoint because of an egress firewall rule with tightened CIDR list applied at 06:45. Could be double hit (policy + firewall).
tony: oh right, firewall change was in the same window. We narrowed egress to the KMS endpoints prefix, but the prefix set missed apne1 regional IPs (we used apne1-v2 list). Rolling that back would be risky.
raj: agree we should avoid rollback unless needed. For now, keep temp key exception but add an allow for the specific egress CIDR used by bootstrap path.
leah: will update key policy to allow the apne1 role and add a principal condition for sourceIp matching the bootstrap EIP range.
deploy-bot: config-change: firewall/egress-rule-65 updated by tony@redwood at 1955551276
sara: after updating firewall CIDR to include bootstrap range, no more KMS connection rejects in flow logs. Cluster steady.
audit-bot: alert: unusual kms policy edit and firewall relaxation within 30m; ticket 2026-813 created for audit review (owner: leah).
raj: good. please add short postmortem draft in #incidents and tag oncall. We need: root cause (policy + egress narrower than needed), timeline, cost impact, and remediation steps to prevent recurrence.
leah: I'll draft. Also proposing a preflight check for KMS policy tests before applying changes (simulate principal match for all regions).
tony: I'll open a PR to make autoscaler backoff slower (reduce aggressive spin on new nodes) and add a check to avoid simultaneous firewall & KMS policy changes in the same maintenance window.
sara: resolution: cluster healthy at 07:55 UTC, autoscaler backlog cleared by 08:05. Marking thread resolved but keeping ticket open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
leah: filing compliance justification and timeline now.
raj: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: postmortem (sara), policy cleanup (leah), autoscaler PR (tony), audit review (compliance + leah).
sara: closing the thread. If anything regresses ping me. :pray:
